purpose: Read-only diagnosis of observed unknown prediction mechanisms in the frozen raw first-pass results; no model, rule, script, score, admission or evidence changes.

access_and_use_restrictions.notes: Do not add this diagnostic or its private references to any stage-three learner allowlist. A2718/A3141 remain subject to DEVIATIONS-002; this diagnostic does not decide final admission.

coverage.input_hash_limit: Recorded model-result input_sha256 was matched to declaration provenance; exact source job.json is separately SHA-bound. No assumption about broker canonical serialization is made.

prediction_channel_difference.A: Protocol-003 requires declared task prediction to equal the immutable behavior_model.predict(observation,intent) output including JSON types. All 87 declared A outputs matched their frozen function result and model SHA. The task LLM could not override these unknowns with its own inference.
prediction_channel_difference.B: The same configured Solar LLM declares a prediction using frozen natural-language rules and current UI, without an executable predictor. B declarations may explicitly generalize beyond directly observed identities while retaining stated uncertainty.
prediction_channel_difference.interpretation_limit: This diagnoses this particular implementation and input contract. Low A coverage does not establish general ineffectiveness of executable models, and the stop-protocol deviations prevent treating all raw trials as a clean compliant method comparison.

a_mechanism_summary.scope_guard_note: A3141 whole_task/steps rejection and A2718 task scope rejection are explicit frozen-model policy branches. They are observed task-interface/coverage limitations, not automatically executor errors. Classification uses the first actual return branch; alternative possible guards were not counted as if executed.

b_unknown_basis.note: Counts rely on graded unknown fields plus explicit declared outputs and unknown rationales. An unknowns list alone does not imply graded unknown: many B records carry caveats yet declare three scorable correct fields.

metric_distinctions.task_success: Independent real-site business-goal result; a task can pass after the LLM executes UI even when the frozen prediction remains unknown.
metric_distinctions.cli_exit_zero: Process-level normal termination; does not itself establish business success or prediction availability/correctness.
metric_distinctions.declared_prediction_coverage: 176/180 valid task declarations overall; A87/90, B89/90. This differs from non-unknown prediction-field coverage A3/270, B233/270.
metric_distinctions.no_causal_claim: No causal method superiority, universal generalization, strict speed ratio or coverage-adjusted rescore is asserted.
